question: Which Union Ministry announced the launch of the 'Amazon Future Engineer Programme?'

options.text: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Tribal Affairs**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ministry of Tribal Affairs** announced the launch of the 'Amazon Future Engineer Programme.'
 
• This program aims to provide computer science education to students from underserved and underrepresented communities.
 
• It includes initiatives like coding classes, scholarships, and internships to help students build a future in technology.
 
• The program is part of a broader effort to bridge the digital divide and ensure equitable access to technology education.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Ministry of Tribal Affairs** is responsible for the overall development and welfare of scheduled tribes in India.
 
• It implements various schemes and programs aimed at improving the socio-economic conditions of tribal communities.
 
• The ministry also focuses on education, health, and livelihood opportunities for the tribal population.
 
• Collaboration with private organizations like Amazon helps in leveraging technology and resources for the benefit of these communities.
 
• The 'Amazon Future Engineer Programme' is one such initiative that aligns with the ministry's goals of promoting education and skill development among tribal students.
